verdict.rationale: GitLab supports rule-based automation via CI/CD pipelines, agent guardrails, and policy-driven triggers (e.g. 'automating repetitive tasks based on the rules and guardrails you set', security scanners triggering on events, audit evidence collection per pipeline), which aligns with automation-on-events for AI-native workflows. However, the evidence lacks detail on a dedicated declarative rule engine specifically for AI agent actions (e.g. explicit event-trigger-action configuration UI/API for AI agents) and no independent/hands-on validation of this specific automation-depth capability is provided. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a rules/trigger engine for AI agent actions, independent verification/hands-on proof of the automation working as described, and detail on event types supported beyond CI/CD and security scanning.
